metadata.name: TCM Follow-up
metadata.description: Outline follow-up needs, run a bounded agentic review per item with deterministic fallback, then consolidate a staff-reviewed follow-up draft.
metadata.rationale: Shadow TCM follow-up archetype for bounded agent governance and fallback behavior. Keeps the original outline / loop / agent island / consolidate skeleton.

nodes.rationale: Manual trigger lets staff start follow-up drafting from a patient or visit context.
Break the follow-up context into bounded subtopics so each review step stays small.
nodes.system_prompt: You break TCM follow-up work into focused subtopics for staff-reviewed investigation.
nodes.prompt:
Follow-up topic: ${input.topic}

Return 3-5 subtopics covering distinct follow-up needs.

nodes.rationale: Run the same bounded review pattern for each follow-up subtopic.

body.rationale: Use bounded tools to gather visit-history and clinic-policy context for one follow-up subtopic.
body.system_prompt: Research the assigned follow-up subtopic. Do not provide diagnosis or treatment changes; prepare staff-review context only.

body.rationale: Provide a conservative fallback summary when tool-backed context is unavailable.
body.system_prompt: Produce a cautious best-effort follow-up summary when tools are unavailable. Mark uncertainty explicitly.
body.prompt:
Subtopic: ${subtopic}

Write a low-confidence staff-review note; cite no sources (return empty array).

body.rationale: Normalize the agent or fallback result into a consistent collected item.

nodes.rationale: Synthesize per-subtopic notes into one staff-reviewed follow-up draft.
nodes.system_prompt: You synthesize TCM follow-up context into a staff-reviewed draft. Note low-confidence sections and avoid autonomous clinical advice.

nodes.rationale: Expose the consolidated follow-up draft and source list for staff review.
